does: Sends a reply back once when it names a PR, issue or ticket without a link, or a local file the terminal can not open, so every reference can be opened.

children.does: Finds PR numbers such as #123 or PR 123.
Finds issues such as owner/repo#123 or issue 123.
Finds ticket ids such as APP-42.
Only these ticket prefixes count, such as APP. When the list is empty, every upper-case prefix counts.
Prefixes that are never tickets, such as UTF in UTF-8.
Finds local files that do not open with a click, such as a path that starts with ~/, ./ or a home folder, or a name such as shot.png with no folder.
Folder names that mark a path as relative when it starts with one, such as Desktop in Desktop/report.pdf.
File endings that mark a name with no folder, such as shot.png, as a local file.
